registry_context.note: The older registry contains a broader Palomar/POSS-I research line. This run tests the April 12 1950 nine-source morphology/rate problem and does not validate the older nuclear-correlation claim.

target.reported_composition: eight star-like detections plus one with possible elongation

source_inputs.title: Exploring nine simultaneously occurring transients on April 12th 1950
used_for: average FWHM approximately 7 arcsec for glint gate
near-geosynchronous angular speed example approximately 15 arcsec/s
natural fast-transient rate example 1.63 deg^-2 day^-1

source_inputs.title: On the nature of apparent transient sources on the National Geographic Society-Palomar Observatory Sky Survey glass copy plates
used_for: all nine transient profile statistics on negative/sharp side with eta approximately -3 to -1
approximately 8000 classifier-bad detections brighter than E=19.5 on E0070
all nine classified bad by the random-forest analysis
DSS and SSS copy-plate provenance dependency

source_inputs.title: On the Image Profiles of Transients in the Palomar Sky Survey
source_inputs.note: Recorded because it argues that sub-second flashes can be sharper/rounder than long-exposure stellar images; no numeric gate in this run depends on it.

natural_fast_transient_null.assumption: independent uniform events in sky area and time at the quoted literature rate
natural_fast_transient_null.conservative_note: The quoted rate reaches substantially fainter limits than POSS-I; using it at face value does not make the null artificially stricter for POSS-I.

stellar_profile_null.assumption: the nine detections are independent random draws from the dominant stellar-profile N(0,1) population

moving_glint_forward_gate.note: This is a kinematic/photometric feasibility gate, not a population or historical-origin model.

broad_copy_plate_artifact_spatial_null.distribution: Binomial for a fixed pre-specified 10x10 arcmin window
broad_copy_plate_artifact_spatial_null.critical_caveat: The approximately 8000 'bad' detections are a broad classifier class and are not all demonstrated to be morphology-matched analogues of the nine transients. Treat the f=1 calculation as a deliberately broad upper-envelope artifact null, not as the probability of the emulsion-hole hypothesis.

analytic_cross_checks: Poisson survival probability for natural-transient null
standard-normal tail product for morphology null
exact Binomial survival probability for broad artifact spatial null

T1_natural_fast_transient_rate_null.interpretation: Nine independent ordinary fast transients in this field and exposure are not reproduced by the quoted natural-event-rate null.

T2_stellar_profile_null.interpretation: The nine-source sharp-profile pattern is not consistent with nine ordinary random stellar-profile draws. This does not distinguish a short real flash from a plate/copy artifact.

T3_moving_glint_kinematic_gate.interpretation: The point-like appearance can be forward-reproduced for sufficiently short flashes; this establishes feasibility, not that such an object existed in 1950.

T4_broad_copy_plate_artifact_spatial_nul.interpretation: Cluster count by itself cannot reject a broad copy/plate-artifact population if every classifier-bad detection is treated as eligible. The result changes by many orders of magnitude if only a small fraction of those detections are true morphology-matched analogues, so an empirical matched-artifact density is a required next measurement.
T4_broad_copy_plate_artifact_spatial_nul.look_elsewhere_warning: The 10x10 window was discovered because it contains the cluster rather than frozen a priori. A rigorous plate-wide scan requires a frozen search algorithm and an explicit look-elsewhere correction.

T5_copy_provenance_independence_gate.reason: The 2024 reanalysis reports that the DSS and SSS POSSI glass copy negatives descend from a common intermediate copy positive, so the two scans are not independent with respect to flaws introduced before the split.

T6_45_vs_50_min_exposure_sensitivity.purpose: robustness to the 45/50 min wording difference across papers

summary: The ordinary independent fast-transient-rate null fails by an extreme margin under the stated inputs.
The nine detections are collectively too sharp to behave like ordinary stellar-profile draws.
A moving flash at approximately 15 arcsec/s can remain point-like only on a sub-second timescale; the simple forward gate reproduces the published scale.
The copy-plate artifact explanation remains viable because copy-chain provenance is shared and because a broad population of bad detections exists.
The present run cannot choose between a real sub-second optical flash/glint and a copy/emulsion artifact.

next_required_evidence: Original POSS-I negative plate or a trustworthy scan of the original negative, not only a descendant copy plate.
Intermediate copy-positive inspection or equivalent provenance-resolving evidence.
Empirical density of morphology-matched sharp transient-like defects, rather than the whole approximately 8000-object 'bad' classifier class.
Blind plate-wide search with frozen detection thresholds and explicit look-elsewhere correction.
Forward injection into real POSS-I backgrounds with empirical PSF, plate response, valid-pixel mask, scanner response and source-recovery pipeline.
Use the exact nine source coordinates and measured per-source morphology/magnitude vector for posterior predictive scoring.
At least 20 pre-frozen blind POSS-I control fields before any detector-specific threshold tuning.
limitations: No original photographic plate pixels were available to this run.
No live SuperCOSMOS/MAST catalogue query was ingested; literature summary statistics were used.
The broad artifact spatial null uses the nominal 6x6 degree plate area and treats all classifier-bad detections as eligible only for a sensitivity envelope.
The simple moving-glint gate is kinematic and does not model a specific reflector geometry, phase function, attitude history, atmosphere or material.
No claim about artificial technology, extraterrestrial origin, UAP identity or a nuclear causal mechanism is admitted by this result.
execution_policy: Numbers labeled as results are computed from explicitly listed source inputs or deterministic formulas. Literature observations are kept separate from simulated outcomes. Unavailable evidence is marked unavailable rather than backfilled.
